sections.content: Lange had been saved by the boy with the mystic sword and the young man with the mystic shield, but the magical power that the 3 mystic weapons released became a menacing shadow that attacked them. Recalling the memories the mystic armor had shown him, Lange prompted the boy to release the full power of the mystic sword. As if responding to the boy's will, a colossal divine being manifested from it. The intense battle that followed destroyed the ruins, burying with them a lot of the clues hinting at the existence of other worlds. However, this did not discourage Lange from his research. Instead, he simply decided to study something new.

|member = |gamedebut = |aliases = |counterpart = Spike Armor Lange |bf2 = true }} '''Lange''' is a character introduced in Brave Frontier II. ==In-Game Appearance== ==Background== ==History== ===Brave Frontier Heroes=== Lange had been saved by the boy with the mystic sword and the young man with the mystic shield, but the magical power that the 3 mystic weapons released became a menacing shadow that attacked them. Recalling the memories the mystic armor had shown him, Lange prompted the boy to release the full power of the mystic sword. As if responding to the boy's will, a colossal divine being manifested from it. The intense battle that followed destroyed the ruins, burying with them a lot of the clues hinting at the existence of other worlds. However, this did not discourage Lange from his research. Instead, he simply decided to study something new. ==Artwork== {{CharacterImage |name = Lange |element = Thunder |image1 = Navi chara bf2 129 0.png |image1note = Neutral |image2 = Navi chara bf2 129 1.png |image2note = Happy |image3 = Navi chara bf2 129 2.png |image3note = Angry |image4 = Navi chara bf2 129 3.png |image4note = Sad |image5 = Navi chara bf2 129 4.png |image5note = Shock |image6 = Navi chara bf2 129 5.png |image6note = Hurt }} {{CharacterImage |name = Lange with Battle Armor |element = Thunder |image1 = Navi chara bf2 130 0.png |image1note = Neutral |image2 = Navi chara bf2 130 1.png |image2note = Happy |image3 = Navi chara bf2 130 2.png |image3note = Angry |image4 = Navi chara bf2 130 3.png |image4note = Sad |image5 = Navi chara bf2 130 4.png |image5note = Shock |image6 = Navi chara bf2 130 5.png |image6note = Hurt |image7 = Navi chara bf2 133 0.png |image7note = }} ==Trivia==
